kind: Reviewed candidate identity recorded before publication, not a post-push receipt

protection.canonical_and_old_immutable_evidence: Every original file outside the explicit active-file allowlist retains baseline SHA256. This includes all prior papers, PDFs, scripts, historical runs, library immutable snapshots/reviews/correction records and canonical.

storage_note: Large exact verifier manifests are losslessly gzip-compressed with original byte hashes and reversible path mappings. Duplicate raw payloads are archived once. Derived readable indexes are labeled and do not replace the preserved complete raw evidence. Existing frozen evidence is unchanged.
